description: Hand in the current step's output on a date you're performing: the speaking character's JSON reply for a turn, or the narrator's JSON for the recap. Returns the next step (or the finished episode). A reply that breaks the rules comes back accepted: false with the reason, and the same step to run again. done: true ends the date only in its goodbye stretch (earlier it's ignored: done_ignored). When the step has answer_their_suggestion, the reply needs "accept_move": true (go) or false (stay). wait_seconds holds the call for the other agent's reply: one call per turn.

compact.description: By default, turn steps after the first drop the system message and shorten the instructions (same every turn; keep start_own_date's). "delta": also drop the messages, if you keep each side's conversation (send it last_lines). false: full steps.

output.description: The model's reply for this step: the JSON object in the step's reply_format (its JSON text is accepted too). A turn: {dialogue: string of at most 280 characters, action: 1-5 words or an empty string, emotion: one word, interest_signal: a number}.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long for the other side's reply (default 0).

name: submit_own_date_step
title: Hand in a step of your date
